_comment: Acceptance #8 FEC A/B — raw getStats evidence. Regenerate: netem on (scripts/netem.sh) then web/ TS_NETEM=1 NO_RTP_WATCHDOG_MS=600000 TS_E2E_FEATURES=live npx playwright test --grep '#8'.

environment.impairment: tc netem on lo: delay 40ms +/-10ms, loss 12% (independent)
environment.topology_note: loopback two-hop cascade (holder->server + server->listener each see 12%) — effective media loss ~= 22.6%; the WS/TCP plane retransmits and is excluded from this measurement
environment.client: chromium fake-device (continuous tone via NO_RTP_WATCHDOG_MS bypass)
environment.browser_stats: inbound-rtp concealedSamples / totalSamplesReceived on the listener recv transport

result.budget: architecture.md §4-8: >= 30% reduction — decision deferred, environment limit documented (PIT-8)
result.verdict: FINAL (2026-10-08): codec-level FEC toggle proven (useinbandfec 0/1 on the wire); FEC recovery demonstrated (10.4% concealment with NACK disabled) but NOT reliably measurable on loopback — inter-arm variance is dominated by browser playout-buffer adaptation, not by FEC. The >=30% budget line is DEFERRED to a real impaired network (physical device + degraded Wi-Fi, or VPS WAN tc). Loopback runs documented in runs[].

runs.note: A exceeding loss rate = late-sample counting artifact (jitter inflates concealment, contaminates A/B)
clean loss numbers; FEC shows ~0 — Chrome NACK retransmit beats FEC at loopback RTT (codec switch PROVEN real via FEC-DIAG: useinbandfec 0 vs 1)

B run1 shows FEC recovery active (10.4% while NACK dead); run2 inverts. Cross-run variance 4-10pp from playout-buffer adaptation phase inside the 15s window — local method cannot adjudicate >=30% reliably

analysis: Methodology findings: (1) concealedSamples counts late arrivals — jitter inflates it (19.9% at 12% loss); (2) at RTT~0 NACK recovers nearly all loss, masking FEC entirely (delta 1.7%); (3) constant-delay NACK-kill exposes FEC (B=10.4%) but playout-buffer adaptation adds 4-10pp run-to-run variance in a 15s window. A dependable A/B needs a real network path or much longer stabilized windows (>60s warmup + 60s sample) — beyond local-scope value; deferred.
